claims.assertion: Goedegebuure proposes /allamminna/i-/ for the city lexeme and analyses KARAHÖYÜK §1 accordingly. The competing name analysis is reported in her discussion, not independently rechecked in its earlier publications.

The four selected table rows support her discussion of separate mi signs. Keep uncertainty in grammatical classification separate from uncertainty attached to the written form. These are her reported attestations, not four new objects or independent witnesses.
